klingon_latin.notes: Star Trek Klingon (tlhIngan Hol) Latin orthography

buy_bear.notes: Standard Klingon OVS imperative: object 'bear' + prefix 'yI-' + verb 'je'' (buy)

klingon_piqad.notes: Star Trek Klingon in pIqaD, encoded in the ConScript Unicode Registry block U+F8D0-U+F8FF (one code point per Klingon letter: tlh, ch, gh, ng and ' are single letters). Drawn with Constructium (Kreative Software, SIL OFL 1.1; see stimuli/fonts/Constructium-LICENSE.txt).

buy_bear.notes: "Buy a bear." Latin transliteration: mIl'oD yIje'. Letters: m I l ' o D / y I j e ' + KLINGON FULL STOP (pIqaD has no exclamation mark). mIl'oD 'type of animal, sabre bear' (KGT); je' 'buy, purchase' (TKD); yI- imperative prefix, 3rd-person singular object (TKD, imperative prefixes). Uses mIl'oD instead of the English word 'bear' that klingon_latin currently has; the two should be reconciled with the Latin-translation fix.

elvish_tengwar.notes: Sindarin in Tengwar, Mode of Beleriand (vowels written as full letters, not tehtar). Encoded in the ConScript/UCSUR Tengwar block U+E000-U+E07F as laid out by the Free Tengwar Font Project mapping. Drawn with Constructium (Kreative Software, SIL OFL 1.1; see stimuli/fonts/Constructium-LICENSE.txt).

buy_bear.notes: Same sentence as elvish_sindarin: Gwedho medli. Tengwar: anga + w-tehta (gw), yanta (e), anto (dh), anna (o) / vala (m), yanta (e), ando (d), lambe (l), short carrier (i), double pusta (full stop). gw as anga + w-tehta is the likeliest reading (no attested example); ungwe is the alternative.
